text:
anya: Heads up — planning a coordinated version bump to v2.3.0 across api, runtime, console, and js-sdk. Cutoff is Friday 11:59pm PT. Please confirm PRs or blockers.
jordan: On it. API PR #834 is ready but waiting on runtime changes. Runtime has a perf tweak that may change defaults — is that considered breaking?
anya: We want non-breaking by default. If it's breaking, flag it and we'll do a canary rollout with feature flag. @linh can you confirm whether the runtime tweak changes public config shape?
linh: The perf tweak renames an internal runtime param in the config. It doesn't change the HTTP API, but js-sdk default needs updating. I'll open a js-sdk PR to align defaults.
sam: Console has a small UI tweak for the model selector tied to the runtime default. PR #412, will ship on canary. CI green locally but we've seen flaky Windows tests in past runs.
devops: Reminder: branch naming for this release should follow release/v2.3.0. Backports go to release/v2.x as needed. Tagging policy: each tag must reference changelog entries and a signed-off line.
jordan: Also need to bump model-serving image tag used by e2e. I'll open a tiny PR to update docker-compose used by integration.
anya: If anyone expects a breaking change, ping me before Thursday 5pm PT. Otherwise we'll merge on Friday morning and cut the tag at 14:00 PT.
olivia: Quick question — for SDK semver, does a default behavior change in runtime require a minor bump for js-sdk?
anya: Yes, default-behavior changes should be a minor bump. So js-sdk goes 0.4.x -> 0.5.0. Other SDKs that only have docs or minor fixes can be patch bumps. Add changelog under "compatibility".
sam: I'll add the changelog notes. Also propose a 30-min post-cut bake window (14:00–14:30 PT) to watch metrics and rollback if needed.
anya: :thumbsup: good plan. @ci-bot, can merges be paused during the tag process?
ci-bot: Deploy bot: I will pause merges to protected branches during the cut window if the release flag is set. Run `/release prepare v2.3.0` on Friday to start the process.
jordan: I'll run `/release prepare v2.3.0` Friday 13:30 PT.
linh: JS-SDK PR opened: #220 — includes default config bump and a changelog draft.
olivia: python-sdk PR posted: #77 — needs a quick review from @jordan and @sam.
sam: Reviewing now, should be quick.
anya: Quick checklist reminder for everyone's PRs: 1) changelog entry, 2) interop tests green, 3) integration smoke run passing, 4) migration note if applicable.
jordan: Interop run timed out first attempt, increased CI timeout and rerunning. Will update when green.
jordan: Interop green on second run.
anya: Perfect. If we have blockers by Thu 5pm PT we delay the cut; otherwise plan stands. Thanks all.
